class: Posting page share-link textbox falsely caused submission guard to intercept opening Apply button as final submit
symptom: Tri-City Group (BambooHR): clicking 'Apply for This Job' was denied by SubmissionGuardV0 with SUBMISSION_GUARD_V0_DENIED, halting the application on the job posting.
root_cause: BambooHR job postings contain a 'Link to This Job' share textbox holding the URL alongside social sharing buttons. posting_entry.py's structural query queried document.querySelectorAll('form, [role="dialog"], iframe, input:not([type="hidden"]), textarea, select') and treated this non-form URL input as proof of an embedded application form, causing postingEntry to return false and submission_guard to treat 'Apply for This Job' as a final submit attempt.
why_tests_missed: Existing structural posting tests had only the Apply button and navigation chrome. None had a job-share link input on the posting page.
fix: Added isJobShareLink to posting_entry.py to classify read-only or URL-holding share inputs as siteChrome, disarmed submission guard while on job description in browser_automation.py protect_submission(), and reset circuit breaker and posting reload counters on reload in page_agent.py.
prevention: Job posting URL sharing inputs and non-application utility boxes must be explicitly classified as chrome so structural posting checks recognize that the posting does not yet hold an application.
